alt: Report Figure 37 - manually segmented STL ground truth

text:
Timing: 1:05

Talk track:
Explain the full target lineage. CT volumes were segmented into the four bones in 3D Slicer, assisted by TotalSegmentator and surface smoothing, then exported as STL meshes. Each surface was transformed into one common LPS grid and voxelised as a separate binary channel. These masks supervise decoder training and act as the held-out reference for Dice and ASSD. State the annotation-validation limitation clearly.

[Sources]
- 24020059_Capstone_2.docx, pp. 83-85, 109-110; four-bone target construction and Figure 37

Explain that identical front-end checkpoints establish fairness, but do not guarantee that the representation is strong. Fold 4 had weak cross-view evidence, and small bones were already the hardest before decoder comparison.

Talk track:
Present the overall subject-level result. V-style beats U-style, but the factorial arms reveal why: residual topology drives the gain. PReLU alone is neutral, and slightly worsens the residual condition. Avoid claiming that full V-Net universally beats 3D U-Net.
